name: Sergia
description: Sergia was a desert planet in the Inner Rim of the galaxy. The Alliance to Restore the Republic operated a refueling station on the planet. When Imperial probes were reported to be close to the rebel refueling station, Luke Skywalker was sent to draw them away.
lead_paragraphs: Sergia was a desert planet in the Inner Rim of the galaxy. The Alliance to Restore the Republic operated a refueling station on the planet. When Imperial probes were reported to be close to the rebel refueling station, Luke Skywalker was sent to draw them away.
